mechanism: Bisacodyl-induced diarrhea and increased intestinal motility may reduce amikacin absorption if taken orally, while amikacin nephrotoxicity combined with bisacodyl-induced fluid/electrolyte depletion increases renal injury risk.
action: Separate administration times by 2+ hours; monitor renal function and electrolytes closely; maintain adequate hydration; consider alternative laxatives if amikacin therapy is prolonged.
